name: io.github.schneidavie/fund-momentum
title: Fund Momentum
description: Agentic fundraising intelligence: 1100+ tracked VC funds and 710 disclosed LPs over MCP

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: API key. Optional: search_funds, get_fund, get_changes (7-day window) and check_lp_coverage answer 10 calls per caller per UTC day with no key at all. No registration or email is required. Agents self-register at https://fundmomentum.vc/_api/agent/register with just an agent_name and get a key plus 25 free credits usable on all six fund tools, or skip keys entirely and pay per call over MPP (Tempo USDC) when a paid tool answers HTTP 402. check_lp_coverage is free and keyless; LP records (search_lps) need an LP Radar subscription at https://fundmomentum.vc/lp-radar and are never sold per call. A free human key (100 calls/month) is at https://fundmomentum.vc/pricing.
